My family has a house on one of the great lakes and a jetski. I'm a girl who recently graduated from high school and is going off to college in the fall. Use your imagination about my appearance. I'm pretty sporty and adventurous.

Yesterday was exceptionally warm and sunny so I took a 20 minute jetski trip to a beach near us that basically nobody knows about. It is hidden by a bunch of tall grass/reeds and nothing is around but a few farms. Since I have never seen anyone out there, I like to take a blanket, beach the jetski, and lie in the sun naked. It's a great way to get a good tan and it feels amazing. I got there yesterday and like every other time, nobody was around. I put the jetski on the beach and stripped down and then laid down on the towel. After a few minutes I thought I heard something. I looked around and guessed it was nothing and laid back down. I closed my eyes and that was when I heard a clear conversation in Spanish.

A group of workers from the nearby farm had come down to swim at the beach. They came out of the brush about 15 feet away from me as I'm lying there totally naked. There was some shouting and they were still coming towards me and I got scared so I jumped up and took off as fast as I could. I grabbed the lifejacket with the jetski key attached but left my towel and the top and bottom to my bikini. I took off as fast as I could and it wasn't until I was about a mile out that I realized I was totally naked riding a jetski off the coast. The life jacket did an ok job functioning as a top, but I still had to ride for 20 minutes past tons of people with my bare ass showing. I definitely got a lot of double takes.

The whole thing was terrifying at the time but now that it's done and I'm clothed again, it was pretty funny.

There were many continuity mistake...

Like, goku used a tactor to plow is field, but when he was not even 12 years old, he use to plow field wioth his bear hand and he did it faster than tractor or any other adult worker.

Then, Goten is affraid of falling of a cliff... He can fly, he can turn into a super saiyan a lift a tractor easily. That make no sense

Trunk and Goten had to use many, many strike to beat a simple snake.

All those thing make me worried about the series. I kind of feel like the power creep is just dead and there is no action scene in this series that will match what happened in Z or GT.

On the bright side, Goku still is Goku, which is the most important part of any DB series.

This was the first episode, so im still hoping for the best. ANY dragon ball is better than no dragon ball, I am enjoying this veyr much, but I think there is no way this is going to match what years of no new DB has hyped up into my brain.

I really bet Goku is using the tractor simply because Akira Toriyama loves drawing cars and things. Or maybe who ever hired him told him he had to use the tractor. I dunno.

I think Goten driving off the cliff and being scared was probably some light hearted humor. That or he was embarrassed in front of his dad and just panicked.

Not sure about the snake fight. They can lower and raise their power level. Maybe they just fought at a low power level. I dunno. I'm sure it'll scale which each fight. Hopefully it stays consistent.

1) Goku's employer probably wanted him to use the tractor, or perhaps Chi Chi wanted him to act like a normal person while working.

2) Classic DB humor?

3) I don't think they wanted to kill the snake. It's obvious they weren't going all out.

1. I always thought that Goku was a freelance radish farmer... At least, I know he is a radish farmer when he is not fighting (like in the gap between DB and DBZ. It was said in Yo!   2. Whats fun about children able to fly falling down a cliff and being scared of it?

  3. They could still have knocked the snake unconscious with a flick of a finger, or just fly away if they didnt want to hurt the snake.

I thought long and hard about thise, those scene make no sense, unless toriyama decided to completely abandon any continuity to the previous series, which make me very sad.

The typical fight with dinosaurs and other huge fauna are normal for the DB series. I remember Gohan killing and eating dinosaurs at like age seven. Trunks and Goten didn't look like they were in trouble with the giant snake and were just dealing with it in a light-hearted/gentle manner. They didn't want to kill it with one punch-through.

Goku using a tractor is him trying to be more human I think. Maybe he was doing some thing automatic/easy (the machine does the work) while he wishes/day dreams he was at King Kai's? Goten falling was kinda silly as well, but I think they're trying to add Goku's character trait (flaw ;p?) of being so naive and innocent.

I enjoy them making Gohan continue his studying. They needed a smart Z fighter who could study lore, ancient myths and other things of that nature so when shit goes down, he can inform everyone. The glasses are silly, but I think he's trying to pull the Clark Kent look (as he's a superhero now) and probably trying to disguise him self.
